metadata.name: file_reader
metadata.description: Read and summarize text-based file types only. Prefer read_file for text formats; use execute_shell_command for type detection when needed. PDF/Office/images/archives are handled by other skills.

metadata.name: pdf
metadata.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill.

metadata.name: procurement
metadata.description: 金汉隆智能采购技能（功能15 供应商评估与智能补货）。用于库存预警、供应商准时率/合格率/综合评分、补货量与最优供应商推荐、比价提示与转人工判定、补货口径解释。双通道：kb_search.py 检索《金汉隆-智能采购》知识库（口径/字段/事实），query.py 对只读计算副本 agent_data.sqlite 执行 SELECT 视图计算。Use for Jinhuanlong procurement: safety-stock alerts, supplier scoring, replenishment quantity & best-supplier recommendation.
